# **Variable List**

```{r Codebook-Chunk, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)







out2 <- ""


# Grab list of surveys
surveys <- unique(blockMap$Survey.LongName)

# For each survey....
for(survey in surveys) {
  
  # Grab survey block
  surveyBlock <- blockMap[(blockMap$Survey.LongName %in% survey),]
  # Knit survey name
  out2 <- paste( 
        out2,
        knit_expand(file = "DataTypes/SurveyName.rmd",
                    survey_name = survey))


  
  # For each survey block in each survey... knit each question
  for(blockIdx in 1:nrow(surveyBlock)) {
    thisBlock <- surveyBlock[blockIdx, ]
    
    if(thisBlock$Item.Type == "Question") {
      attach(thisBlock)
      question_type <- thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name
      question_type_no_space <- gsub(" ", "", question_type)
      
      # Grab chunk labels
        chunk_label <- paste(thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name, thisBlock$Question.ID, blockIdx)
        chunk_label <- gsub(" ", "-", chunk_label)
        # Fail safe to clean any special characters that sneak in
        chunk_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9\\-]", "", chunk_label)
      
      
      out2 <- paste( 
        out2,
        knit_expand(
          file = paste0("DataTypes/", question_type_no_space, ".Rmd"),
          question_text = thisBlock$Question.Text,
          item_id = thisBlock$Item.ID,
          question_type = thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name,
          result_type = thisBlock$Result.Type,
          question_id = thisBlock$Question.ID,
          chunk_label = chunk_label
        )
      )
      detach(thisBlock)
    }
  }  
}




```

`r knit(text=out2)`
